description:
Hushfacebook v0.11.0 targets Facebook 582.0.0.50.54 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release.

This release brings 88 patches, up from 87. The new one is Frame step, which moves a paused reel or video one frame at a time. New switches hide comments with shop links or with words from your News feed list, let Home show just Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages, and save crashes to Downloads. The kept reel progress bar no longer jumps back on the first reel or sits under the caption, Material You reaches the Menu's top card and Log out strip, and the release notes map each reported issue this release touches.

Validation: 2541 runtime tests passed locally. All 886 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 88 patches applied to Facebook 582.0.0.50.54, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 582.0.0.50.54, build 475417104, or its 32-bit build 475417036. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
